customKeycodes.name: Dictate
customKeycodes.title: PowerMic Dictate (button 3). Starts or stops dictation in PowerScribe without it having focus; the pad turns red while PowerScribe records.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Up Slow
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll up at the slow speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the slower speed.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Down Slow
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll down at the slow speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the slower speed.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Up Fast
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll up at the fast speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the faster speed.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Down Fast
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll down at the fast speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the faster speed.

customKeycodes.name: LED FX Next

customKeycodes.name: LED FX Prev
